{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isna().sum()
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {missing_body_mass}')

# Compute the mean body mass, ignoring missing values
mean_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f'Mean body mass: {mean_body_mass}')"}
